correctness.rationale: For an admissible error e, cancellation of the projected row norm against its sampling probability gives the exact decrease ||AP_I e||²/F(I); a least-eigenvalue vector proves sharpness. The four classes have multiplicities 4, 8, 2, 1 and positive spectra respectively (2c²,2s²), (2,4c²s²), (2,2c²,2s²), and (2,2). This gives exactly the stated score minimizers and unique rate maximizer throughout 0<s<1/√2. For the specified common x*, optimal-rate constraints leave error −e2 and each raw draw hits it with probability 1/2; ID constraints leave −e4, have first squared norm c², and from then on a switch of the row multiplies squared norm by (c²−s²)² with conditional probability 1/2. Rejection enforces switching once a row has been used; the optimal-rate system instead stops at the first accepted update. These are different clocks. Independently reproduced 60 projected spectra and 112 exact moment identities using rational projections and branching, with zero projected rows removed before division; replay `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_reproduce.py` (section 5). The packaged verifier was inspected, not executed; it constructs an update operator even at zero projected norm, so filtering is advisable. The finite replay corroborates rather than proves the full parameter and time laws.
residual_risks: Applies to the specified exact arithmetic, consistent, singleton sampling protocol; no floating-point or runtime conclusion.
